name: manual_3e0502
claim: The 'decision accepted but never coded' failure mode recurs across review phases even after being caught once — each subsequent phase must independently re-verify that ALL prior phases' accepted fixes actually landed in the artifact, not just the fixes that phase itself is focused on

decisions.notes: On the G7 SSE plan, the Eng phase caught 3 CEO-accepted fixes that existed only as Decision Audit Trail rows, never in the plan's code. Fixed them. The very next phase (DX review) independently found 2 MORE instances of the exact same pattern (an undefined-variable route handler standing in for real code, and the dropped_events exposure decision never landing anywhere) that both the CEO and Eng phases' own dual-voice passes had missed. One catch does not inoculate a plan against the same failure mode recurring elsewhere in the same document.
